description: Get the global unlock percentage of each achievement in a game by appid — how rare each achievement is across all players. Returns each achievement's internal name and its unlock percent (no display names/descriptions — for those, use get_game_achievements), most-common first, capped at the first 200 (check `returned` vs `count` — most games have far fewer). An unknown appid, one with no achievement schema (e.g. a DLC/soundtrack) and a game without achievements all come back as an empty list rather than an error (Steam answers the three alike), the same as get_game_news. Get the appid from search_games. No API key required.

appid.description: Steam application id (appid). Get it from search_games.

name: get_global_achievements

notes.description: Present only when part of this answer is missing or comes from an older cached copy because Steam failed: what, and why. Read it before relying on the data — a missing part is null/empty because it is unknown, not because Steam has none.

title: Get global achievement rates
